gloss: storefront; in front of a shop

definitions.gloss: storefront; in front of a shop; shop front area
definitions.explanation: The area directly in front of or at the entrance of a shop, including any outdoor display space.

examples.japanese: {店先|みせさき}に{花|はな}が{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: Flowers are lined up in front of the shop.

examples.japanese: {店先|みせさき}で{野菜|やさい}を{売|う}っている。
examples.english: They sell vegetables at the storefront.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}ってきたので、{店先|みせさき}の{軒下|のきした}で{雨宿|あまやど}りした。
examples.english: When it started raining, I took shelter under the eaves of a shop front.

notes:
Composed of {店|みせ} (shop) + {先|さき} (front/ahead). Refers to the area immediately in front of or at the entrance of a shop, often where goods are displayed outdoors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {店先|みせさき}に{並|なら}べる: to display in front of a shop
- {店先|みせさき}で{売|う}る: to sell at the storefront
- {店先|みせさき}に{立|た}つ: to stand at the shop front
- {店先|みせさき}の{看板|かんばん}: a sign at the shop front

USAGE:
Evokes a traditional or small-business atmosphere — fruit stands, flower shops, and local stores that display goods outside. Less commonly used for modern chain stores or malls.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {店頭|てんとう}: shop front, over the counter — more formal; often used in business/financial contexts ({店頭販売|てんとうはんばい}, over-the-counter sales)
- {軒先|のきさき}: under the eaves — specifically the area under the roof overhang, not the full storefront
